review.reviewer: Claude, maintainer-authorized source and dependency review (AF-CTR-05 delegated author, E2a); PR review is recorded separately
review.rationale: AF-CTR-05 part E2a, Cloud (FleetService's node registry on the nodes surface; no routed task method), tested with REAL PostgreSQL, the REAL composed center and WebSocket server and MOCKED nodes (nodetest with software keys); production stays dark (no environment enables the nodes surface): the successor of the admission at cloud-release-r98. The Go sources of the center change: the nodes surface and its routes module (FleetService ListNodes, GetNode, RenameNode, RevokeNode), the operation rows with RelayedScopes and the node target kind, the authorizer's own verification of a node-relayed call (access.WithRelayVerifier, hub.Hub.RelayVerifier), the registry's reads and RenameNode in package fleet with the reported name kept on enrollment and report, ChannelAccepted.node_name, the hub's forgotten late call IDs, and migration 0009_fleet_node_names.sql (expand only); the embedded account page's channel_closed text. The Worker sources change in the generated table (worker/tables/center-tables.generated.ts: the nodes surface and its four rows), so the bundle and its digest change. The tests, the test data and the documents are not part of the image or the bundle. No Go module, npm package, base image, toolchain or legal file changes. The Worker record binds the regenerated table and the new bundle. It supersedes the admission at cloud-release-r98.
